prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: premium travel photograph for SmartTrip V3 static Home; landscape 16:9.
Primary request: An aerial or raised view of a Yunnan-inspired turquoise lake with a dramatic Cangshan-like layered mountain ridge in the background, a small white lakeside village and a winding waterfront road visible.
Style/medium: Sharp photographic detail with premium camera treatment and realistic natural textures.
Composition/framing: Lake fills the central and right 65 percent of the frame, providing clear water areas where route graphics and overlay controls can later remain readable. Mountains occupy the upper third, the small white lakeside village is in the lower-left, and the shoreline creates a strong horizon diagonal. Wide landscape composition, 16:9 aspect ratio.
Lighting/mood: Sunny late-afternoon, clear directional light, bright welcoming tourism visual.
Color palette: Rich blue and slate water with turquoise areas, cool lush green hills, clean white village buildings; avoid muddy beige.
Constraints: No text, no UI, no markers, no logo, no watermark. No route graphics or overlay controls in the photograph itself. Do not make it gloomy.
Context: This is a conceptual generated travel scene inspired by Yunnan; it is not evidence of actual Dali geography.
